run_syscall: run a raw Linux system call by number with arbitrary arguments via libc syscall
run_bpf: run a BPF system call with a command, attribute pointer, and attribute length
get_libc: get a lazy-loaded ctypes handle to libc.so.6 for making low-level C calls
get_errno: get the current thread errno value from libc __errno_location
review_syscall_module: review the _syscall module to understand BPF and raw syscall wrappers for eBPF programs
